our work shows the potential for diffusion weighted imaging (DWI) and (18)FDG-PET to improve the prediction of local control and survival in patients undergoing stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) for non-small cell cancer of the lung.

our study demonstrates that the addition of DWI and PET to the clinical and dosimetric data improves the accuracy for predicting local control and overall survival in patients with non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC) treated with SBRT.
